Tests cover absent mastery, elapsed cost, save/restore, unchanged stock, no mental reward, interruptions, vanished/distant targets and resource prerequisites. The protected controller, budgets, goals and executed prefix remain unchanged.

reviews.reason: Persistent hands-on stone arrangement is not implemented by dropping materials or observing nature. It is a reasonable new capability; use requires actual owned stones, suitable ground and completed work, none of which are supplied by approval.
reviews.specification: Implement versioned arrange_stone_mosaic with public schema {x:number,y:number,offsets:[{dx:number,dy:number}]} (additionalProperties:false; 2–8 offsets). Each offset represents one owned stone unit; select inventory stacks deterministically and retain provenance. Require mastery, positive satiety, energy >=6, and a visible placement disk of radius 0.5 within 0.65 of the actor. Stone centers must lie within that disk, be at least 0.16 apart, remain inside world bounds, and avoid solid geometry, existing arrangements and occupied work areas. Reserve the footprint and escrow the required stones atomically. Work takes three consecutive stationary rounds at 2 energy per round with normal metabolism; revalidate reach, clearance, positive satiety and sufficient energy each round. Movement, incompatible action or failed validation interrupts, releasing reservation and returning escrow to inventory without refunding spent energy; actor removal drops escrow at the work site. Completion converts escrow into a persistent mosaic object with stable ID, creator, creation tick, offsets, unit quantities and provenance, and emits one successful mosaic_completed event plus a personal craftsmanship record. Stones are committed, not destroyed or duplicated. Render actual stone positions in the normal visibility system; expose inspectable contents and creator. Mosaic footprint prevents overlapping placements but is walkable, non-solid, supplies no facility benefit, shade, insulation or ongoing production. Extend nearby pickup to dismantle a mosaic only by its creator within interaction reach, charging existing pickup mass costs and atomically removing it while returning its actual stones; no completion event on dismantling. No mental satisfaction or physical-comfort bonus is introduced. Bind progress, cancellation, completion and removal to event, rendering and personal-memory adapters; record events idempotently. Depend on existing inventory, round/metabolism, geometry, visibility, ownership, pickup and event systems. Migrate with empty mosaic/work collections and no retroactive objects, records, rewards or mastery; preserve existing source history and validate conserved stone totals. Individual study takes two rounds; development and review advance no simulation time.
